task:
  name: site_a_car_expression
  question: Which manufacturing parameters go with final product CAR+ expression at
    SiteA?
  purpose: predictive
  seed: 20260917
inputs:
  pvf: /home/user/pvf_tasks_jan/demo/data/processed/PVF.xlsx

  - column: Type

    op: equals
    value: Y
    missing: exclude
    normalise: false
    reason: manufacturing and testing finished

  exclude:

  hashing_signed: true

  hashing_min_rows: 100
  missing_indicators: false
  impute: none
quality:
  min_non_missing: 8
  duplicate_r2_threshold: 0.99
  duplicate_min_overlap: 8
  near_constant_tolerance: 0.0001
  proxy_correlation: 0.95

  action: report_only
  method: spearman
  threshold: 0.7
  min_size: 2
  min_overlap: 8
  prefer: []

  enabled: true
  threshold: 0.9

  max_rate: 0.95

  max_categories: 20

  max_table_rows: 500
